rationale: Best-supported call is non-AI for the represented CA Performance Management network-monitoring product: retained VA catalog links CA-origin SPIM to DX NetOps and describes monitoring, storage, analysis and display; successor documentation adds predictive analytics but no explicit AI/ML. Analytics and prediction terminology alone do not establish AI. Documentation is not a complete historical feature inventory and exact version applicability remains unverified, so this is weak/forced, not proof that no AI existed.
